statement:
by
  classical
  exact let ch := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length≤2; ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T≤X → (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n : ℕ => n%6=4 ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, ch p ∧ ch q ∧ p+q=n ∧ p^3≤n^2 ∧ n≤p^2))).card:ℝ)≤C*(X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 把一端陈素数限定在 n^(1/2) 到 n^(2/3) 之间，另一端贴近目标。
plain_statement.en: Confine one Chen prime to a sublinear, asymmetric band.

brief.zh: 这里两个筛和长度相差幂次。对短端作分段，再控制长端在反射短窗内的陈筛下界。
brief.en: Treat the short Chen variable dyadically and localize the reflected long-variable minorant.
